description: GH issue #319: reproduce and diagnose two defects in fresh strict cluster startup — (1) ClusterSupervisor starts Link before Foreman, so Link's GenServer.call to Foreman :noproc's; (2) after fixing order, TSLValidationPhase treats a persisted bootstrap with logs: %{} as an old cluster needing log quorum, instead of taking CoreState.fresh?/1's init path.

comments.text:
Reproduced both defects at the mechanism level (no need for a live 3-node BEAM cluster — root causes are deterministic and isolated cleanly):

**Defect 1 — Link/Foreman start order (cluster_supervisor.ex:142-157)**
`Link` is prepended to the children list ahead of `children_for_capabilities(...)`, which is what starts `Foreman` (module_for_capability maps :log/:materializer -> Foreman, cluster_supervisor.ex:252-253). Standalone repro confirms `Link.Discovery.get_running_services_from_foreman/1`'s `rescue` clause (discovery.ex:204-217) does NOT catch the `:exit` signal a dead-process `GenServer.call` raises:

    GenServer.call(:nonexistent_foreman_proc, :get_all_running_services, 1000)
    rescue
      _ -> []
    end
    => uncaught EXIT propagates: {:noproc, {GenServer, :call, [...]}}

Note discovery.ex already has the correct pattern elsewhere in the same file (`try_direct_coordinator_call/2` uses `catch :exit, _ -> {:error, :unavailable}`) — this function just uses the wrong construct.

**Defect 2 — TSLValidationPhase doesn't consult CoreState.fresh?/1 (tsl_validation_phase.ex:55-68)**
`execute(%RecoveryAttempt{}, %{prior_core_state: %{} = core_state})` matches ANY non-nil map for prior_core_state (Elixir's `%{}` pattern matches all maps, not just empty ones) and always routes to LockingPhase on validation success — it never checks `CoreState.fresh?/1` (core_state.ex:132-140), which already exists and already correctly treats `logs: %{}` as fresh. `MaterializerBootstrapPhase` already uses `CoreState.fresh?` this way (materializer_bootstrap_phase.ex:89) — TSLValidationPhase is the outlier.

Confirmed this is baked into the test suite as documented (mis-described) behavior: test/.../tsl_validation_phase_test.exs "transitions to LockingPhase when TSL validation succeeds" passes `logs: %{}` and asserts LockingPhase — this is precisely the fresh-cluster case that should go to InitializationPhase instead.

Downstream: LockingPhase -> ... -> LogRecoveryPlanningPhase (log_recovery_planning_phase.ex:34-73) computes `old_log_ids = CoreState.log_ids(prior_core_state)` = [] for a fresh bootstrap, so `locked_count(0) > total_count(0)/2` is false -> stalls `:unable_to_meet_log_quorum`. Matches the issue exactly.

Fix shape: (1) Discovery.get_running_services_from_foreman should `catch :exit, _ -> []` (or add it alongside/instead of rescue), and/or ClusterSupervisor should start Foreman before Link. (2) TSLValidationPhase should route `CoreState.fresh?(core_state)` cores to InitializationPhase instead of unconditionally LockingPhase, mirroring MaterializerBootstrapPhase's existing check. Existing tsl_validation_phase_test.exs's "TSL validation succeeds" test will need to change expectation from LockingPhase to InitializationPhase for the `logs: %{}` case, and a new case added for genuinely non-empty prior logs still routing to LockingPhase.

title: Fresh strict cluster startup fails on Link/Foreman order and empty-log recovery
